## Problem

What problem would this solve? What's the research or clinical workflow behind
it? ("It would be nice" is harder to act on than "as a researcher I currently
can't ...").

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why this one is better.

## Fit with the project's principles

HashCerebrum is local-first with no backend, no telemetry, and no accounts, and
keeps scoring/extraction deterministic and in-code. Briefly note how the request
fits within those constraints.

## Additional context

Mockups, references, or related issues.
